answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Deviant Sects Question ID: 20584 Country: India Title: why do you consider Ahle Hadees as a devient sect. what are the reasons for it? Question: why do you consider Ahle Hadees as a devient sect. what are the reasons for it? Answer ID: 20584 Posted on: Dec 18, 2023 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 468/320/L=1431) This sect differs from the majority of Ahl al-Sunnah in many issues. It does not believe in the ijma of sahaba as authority; hence it is deviated and diverted from the right path. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
